flags.note: The object phrase 'this one who sits on the throne' precedes the verb 'I saw', matching Greek syntax. Native Hebrew would typically place the verb first or use a different construction.
The construction 'כיון ש' (since that) followed by passive 'was found' mirrors Greek causal clauses. Classical Hebrew would more likely use כִּי or different causal constructions.
The participial construction 'standing... as if slain' with the relative clause structure mirrors Greek participial usage. Hebrew would more naturally use finite verbs.
The demonstrative 'and these' followed by the complex noun phrase before the verb follows Greek word order patterns rather than typical Hebrew VSO structure.
The periphrastic construction 'were falling' using הָיוּ + participle mimics Greek imperfective aspect. Hebrew would typically use simple perfective or wayyiqtol forms.
